text:
devon: kicking off smoke for Horizon LoRA merge — quick eval pack shows a small hallucination spike on product-recommendation prompts after the 4-bit merge :confused:
maria: which prompts exactly? can you paste a failing example? :eyes:
devon: sure — short one: "what would you buy for a budget-conscious photographer?" -> model suggests unrelated medical devices. reproduces on local int4 binary after adapter stitch
alik: ran the smoke command on dedicated node, logs attached: `./smoke_eval --model horizon-merged-v2 --quant int4 --evalset quickshop_small`
amarin-bot: (automated) job 2930456792 started on dedicated-gpu-01
eva: could be tokenizer id remap from the adapter merge. Horizon adapter uses custom vocab offsets, we saw a similar token shift in another customer case
maria: good call — check token id sums before/after merge: `python tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base horizon-base --adapter horizon-lora`
devon: ran tokenmap_diff, output: `offsets: [+3 at 102, -2 at 4096]` — looks like a small shift around the emoji range, but mismatch aligns with hallucination examples
alik: also saw softmax temperature drift in int4 trace; dumping logits for the failing prompt now
sre-bot: deploy-bot noticed increased 5xxs for horizon-merged-v2 in canary; rolling back canary instances to base-1.9 until triage completes :rotating_light:
cust-eng: any ETA? customer flagged this as regression vs their prod finetune. they have a demo tomorrow morning
eva: quick workaround — pin tokenizer map from base and re-run merge script with `--preserve-tokenmap`. that should avoid id remap while we root cause quant rounding
maria: trying preserve-tokenmap now, will run quickpack (10 prompts) and post results in ~8m
devon: also toggled prefix-kv cache to off for the canary (to rule out KV-state interaction with merged weights)
alik: smoke output (snip):
```
PROMPT: what would you buy for a budget-conscious photographer?
BASE (base-1.9): camera kit, tripod, SD cards, lens cloth
MERGED (horizon-merged-v2): portable nebulizer, bandage kit, camera kit
```
seems like the merged model sometimes substitutes unrelated items — token mapping + quantization seems plausible
maria: preserve-tokenmap + remerge finished. quickpack results: 9/10 matched base responses, 1/10 had minor reorder. lowering alarm level to: investigate (not showstopper) :thumbsup:
devon: good — I'll coordinate a full 200-prompt regression run overnight and push a patch to the merge pipeline to add `--preserve-tokenmap` by default for Horizon adapters
cust-eng: appreciate the fast triage. please ping me when full run is done so we can confirm with the customer before their demo
eva: note for postmortem: add a unit test in merge CI that verifies token id parity and a tiny semantic-sanity eval on a fixed seed prompt set
maria: filing a quick ticket: INF-7289 with triage notes and commands used
devon: summary: root likely tokenizer id remap introduced during adapter stitch combined with int4 rounding. short-term: preserve-tokenmap + disable KV caching on canary. long-term: CI checks + seed semantic pack. thanks team! :rocket:
